title: Oil and Natural Gas Corporation Ltd - 500312 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Earnings Call Transcript

summary.headline: ONGC standalone PAT rose over 57% YoY to INR 15,489 crore in Q2 FY27, with record H1 PAT of INR 32,522 crore.
summary.overview: Standalone gross revenue was INR 43,857 crore, up over 33% YoY, on average nomination-field crude realisation of USD 92.33/bbl. Production was broadly flat QoQ and down marginally YoY, hit by DUDP supply-chain delays, offshore weather and an OTPC Tripura offtake shutdown. Other expenses rose on a INR 1,861 crore provision for a terminal excise duty receivable under High Court litigation, partly offset by lower OpEx and exchange loss. Management guided FY27 production to about 39 MMT oe, with 0.5-1 MMT more in FY28, and declared a record first interim dividend of INR 8/share.

financial_highlights.change: incremental INR 2,859 crore vs APM pricing; over 34% of nomination gas revenue
total outgo INR 10,064 crore; highest ever interim

financial_highlights.metric: Provision for terminal excise duty receivable (DGFT)
financial_highlights.change: under High Court litigation; booked on prudence basis

segments.name: Upstream – Mumbai High / TSP
segments.commentary: TSP-1 with BP shows early green shoots in gas; Mumbai High gas up about 7-8% at uptick start. Fixed fee for first two years; performance-linked sharing starts April 2027. TSP for Neelam, Bassein & Satellite awarded in the quarter.

segments.name: Upstream – KG-DWN-98/2
segments.commentary: Oil output about 19,000 bbl/d; gas about 2 MMSCMD in Q2. Three wells to add about 1.5 MMSCMD in Q4 FY27. Subsurface complexity has caused a dip; company targets about 3.5 MMSCMD by FY27 end per analyst question, with no firm upside guidance.

segments.name: Petrochemicals – OPaL
segments.commentary: Q2 EBITDA INR 147 crore and PAT loss INR 494 crore; feedstock costs rose with Hormuz disruption. Interest cost was about INR 2,000 crore last year and is expected to fall after INR 18,000 crore equity infusion and debt refinancing.

segments.name: International – OVL
segments.commentary: Sakhalin H1 average production 183,000 bbl/d, near pre-2022 levels; re-entered December 2025. Mozambique LNG about 49% complete, about USD 7 billion invested, drawdown expected from next month. Venezuela agreements expected in 3-6 months.

guidance_outlook: FY27 oil and gas production about 39 MMT oe, with gradual recovery expected in subsequent quarters.
FY28 production about 0.5-1 MMT higher than FY27.
Samudra Manthan: four deepwater wells planned in FY27; up to 13 wells in FY28 subject to rig availability (two rigs on hire, one operational in Mahanadi).
DUDP about half of wells completed; KG-DWN-98/2 wells to be completed by next quarter; DSF-II volumes expected towards end of FY27.
Capex about USD 3.5-4 billion per year. Dividend payout policy unchanged at about 40%.
OPaL interest cost expected to decline; ethane imports from USA via two ships due early 2029.
capex_capacity: Two Western Offshore development projects awarded at combined investment of about INR 11,800 crore, est. 22 MMT oe potential, completion in 2 to 2.5 years.
Mozambique LNG: about USD 7 billion invested, 49% complete; sovereign guarantee approved and drawdown expected from next month.
Second deepwater rig expected to be mobilised in FY27; Silchar gas to be monetised via IGGL pipeline.
Venezuela San Cristobal (sole operator) and Petro Carabobo (joint operator) agreements expected within 3-6 months; capex not disclosed.
Pipeline replacements under way at Mumbai High to raise gas injection capacity.
demand_pricing: Average nomination-field crude realisation USD 92.33/bbl in Q2.
Management cited Hormuz-related supply disruption raising OPaL feedstock prices; petchem prices had rebounded in the prior quarter.
Deepwater rig market described as tight.
Industry baseline decline assumed at about 6-8% per year; Mumbai High decline is being arrested by TSP.

qa_highlights.question: Drivers of higher other expenses, lower tax rate and higher depreciation?
qa_highlights.answer: Other expenses rose about INR 600 crore net: INR 1,861 crore excise duty provision, offset by INR 609 crore lower OpEx and INR 625 crore lower exchange loss. Tax was lower due to non-taxable dividend income (about INR 80 crore benefit). Depreciation included impairment of long-pending exploratory wells.

qa_highlights.question: Production guidance for FY27, FY28, FY29?
qa_highlights.answer: About 39 MMT oe in FY27 and 0.5-1 MMT higher in FY28. No FY29 figure given.

qa_highlights.question: Samudra Manthan well count and benefit?
qa_highlights.answer: Four wells in FY27 and up to 13 in FY28, rig-dependent. Benefit cannot be quantified as it is exploration.

qa_highlights.question: TSP-1 and KG-DWN-98/2 production and upside, split oil and gas?
qa_highlights.answer: No TSP-specific split; field-level details to be provided separately by IR. KG-98/2 at about 19,000 bbl/d oil; wells pending for gas connection.

qa_highlights.question: OPaL performance and petchem marketing synergies?
qa_highlights.answer: Q2 EBITDA INR 147 crore; synergies from the joint petchem marketing company (OPaL, ONGC, MRPL) not quantifiable yet.

qa_highlights.question: Venezuela and Russia dues and repatriation?
qa_highlights.answer: Venezuela dividends (around USD 500 million) remain unsettled pending new agreements that give offtake rights. Vankorneft dividend stuck in Russia used for Sakhalin abandonment liability; Sakhalin dividend repatriation has no restriction once declared.

qa_highlights.question: Use of excess operating cash flow and dividend policy?
qa_highlights.answer: Capex of USD 3.5-4 billion a year continues, with diversification opportunities considered. Dividend policy unchanged at about 40% payout.

qa_highlights.question: TSP baseline decline and sharing mechanism?
qa_highlights.answer: Contract terms frozen; payouts to be worked out on actual performance towards year end. Industry decline 6-8% per year, with Mumbai High decline being arrested.

risks_watch: Production shortfall vs plan: DUDP delays, offshore weather, OTPC Tripura offtake shutdown; recovery depends on Q4 well connections.
KG-DWN-98/2 subsurface complexity; oil ramp-up path and timeline unclear.
INR 1,861 crore excise duty provision; outcome of High Court case is pending and is a potential reversal.
OPaL losses persist; feedstock cost and ethane supply tie-up are open.
Deepwater rig availability constrains Samudra Manthan FY28 well target of 13.
Venezuela and Russia cash repatriation and the INR 500 million-scale dividend receivable remain unresolved.
summary.management_tone: Confident on earnings and the long-term pipeline, but cautious on near-term volumes and evasive on quantification of TSP, KG-98/2 and Venezuela outcomes, which management said depend on pending agreements or further studies.
key_quotes: We expect a gradual improvement in production and are confident of recovering lost ground in the subsequent quarters.
The board also declared its highest ever interim dividend of 160% that is INR 8 per share with total dividend outgo of INR 10,064 crore.
We are definitely working on how to come back on the 98/2 project.

growth.why: Management guides FY27 production about 39 MMT oe (held) with 0.5-1 MMT more in FY28, backed by three KG-98/2 wells (~1.5 MMSCMD, Q4 FY27), Western Offshore projects (INR 11,800 crore, 2-2.5 years) and Samudra Manthan wells, but production was flat QoQ and slightly down YoY, so outlook is only modestly positive.

rows.label: Margin expansion
rows.why: Nomination-field realisation of USD 92.33/bbl and gas revenue up INR 2,859 crore vs APM pricing support margins, but OPaL losses (Q2 PAT -INR 494 crore) and a INR 1,861 crore excise provision weigh on reported margins.

rows.label: Capacity expansion / commissioning
rows.why: Three KG-DWN-98/2 wells add about 1.5 MMSCMD in Q4 FY27, Western Offshore projects (INR 11,800 crore, 22 MMT oe potential) complete in 2-2.5 years, and Samudra Manthan targets 4 wells in FY27 and up to 13 in FY28 subject to rig availability.

rows.label: Volume growth
rows.why: FY27 production guided at about 39 MMT oe (held) and 0.5-1 MMT higher in FY28, but Q2 output was flat QoQ and slightly down YoY, so growth depends on Q4 well connections and the DUDP ramp.

rows.label: New capex announcement
rows.why: Capex of USD 3.5-4 billion per year continues, with two Western Offshore awards (about INR 11,800 crore) and Venezuela agreements expected in 3-6 months, though utilisation is not disclosed and the call gives no new announcement date.

rows.label: Guidance upgrade
rows.why: FY27 production guidance was only held at about 39 MMT oe and volumes were flat QoQ, so there is no sign of an upward revision.

rows.label: Guidance downgrade
rows.why: Q2 production shortfall from DUDP delays, offshore weather and OTPC Tripura shutdown, with FY27 target relying on recovery in later quarters and KG-98/2 subsurface complexity.

rows.label: New product launch
rows.why: The call did not discuss new products, brands or molecules.

rows.label: Mozambique LNG drawdown and Sakhalin ramp
rows.why: Mozambique LNG is 49% complete with about USD 7 billion invested and drawdown starting next month; Sakhalin H1 average output was 183,000 bbl/d, near pre-2022 levels.

rows.label: OPaL interest cost decline
rows.why: OPaL interest cost was about INR 2,000 crore last year and is expected to fall after an INR 18,000 crore equity infusion and debt refinancing, though OPaL Q2 PAT was -INR 494 crore.

rows.label: Venezuela dividend and offtake resolution
rows.why: Venezuela agreements are expected in 3-6 months, and about USD 500 million of dividends stays unsettled until new offtake-rights agreements are signed.
